answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. No Turned theologian pendulum token, no seat: the rule is plain, and a token theologians wear after doctrine audits is why it holds. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Nobody is waved through free: 120 stamped dockets, each costing $44 to have checked is the price, and the knoll never covers it twice. walnut stays on the record. The tally keeps horizon.
